dynamicPhysicalGuards.qualification: Dynamic wet-domain: changed initially-dry pixels is an observation, not static-wall failure. Grids/steps have different diffusion horizons; no equal-physical-time refinement claim. Float ledgers are separate from final RGBA8 quantization.
dynamicPhysicalGuards.failureScope: Pre-pack format/admissibility failure for the bounded C/A<=1 prototype, not a universal rejection of physical pigment compression. Two grid256/96 cases overflow before RGBA packing; final invalidPremul=0 alone does not establish admissibility.
